svg.title: Where Sumatran orangutans live
svg.desc: A simplified map of the island of Sumatra in Indonesia. Sumatran orangutans live only at the northern tip, and about nine out of ten of the 11,694 that remain live inside a single forest, the Leuser Ecosystem, which covers 2.6 million hectares and is the last place on Earth where orangutans, tigers, rhinos and elephants share the same habitat. Rescued orangutans have been released at Jantho in the north and Bukit Tigapuluh further south.

text.font-family: Georgia, serif
